text:
fran_partner: Hey team — quick sync. Cryptolock (HSM vendor) asked for a coordinated marketplace + BYO-HSM launch. They want SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, and a KMS BYOK flow validated before the joint announcement. Can we confirm a go/no-go checklist and owners?

alex_m: I can own the KMS BYOK integration validation. Need sample key wrapping unwrap flow from Cryptolock and expected latency targets for encryption operations.

sara_pm: I'll own the marketplace listing + announcement timing. Proposed timeline: internal GA readiness by 2025-06-02, joint press 2025-06-09, partner webinar 2025-06-16. Thoughts?

jordan_eng: For SAML/SCIM: we need Cryptolock's IdP metadata (entityID, x509 cert, ACS URL) and SCIM provisioning schema mapping (email/name/role). Also need to confirm SCIM rate limits and patching plan for attributes changing.

emma_sales: Cryptolock asked for co-branded docs and a joint demo that shows end-to-end BYOK key import + model-serving encryption. They prefer a short script they can run.

fran_partner: Good. I pinged their PM and asked for the metadata + a staging KMS endpoint. They replied they'll provide an SFTP with artifacts and a test key.

alex_m: For BYOK validation checklist draft (high-level):
1) Key import flow validated (wrap/unwrap)
2) KMS encryption/decryption latency within SLA (p50, p95)
3) Rotation and revocation exercises
4) Audit logs show key usage with request IDs
5) Fallback plan if partner KMS unavailable

jordan_eng: Add security checklist:
- Verify SAML cert rotation works without user disruption
- SCIM delta sync for group/role changes tested
- Ensure we do not store partner private keys locally
- Threat model sign-off by secops

sara_pm: Can we get a lightweight rollout matrix? Staging -> limited beta customers -> general availability. Need a gating item: legal embargo signed + joint messaging approved.

emma_sales: Also add channel enablement: sales playbook + pricing note for Dedicated + Private (BYOK may affect pricing).

ops_bot: created ticket PART-4187 for KMS BYOK validation and assigned to alex_m (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PART-4187)

alex_m: Quick technical ask to Cryptolock: can you confirm your HSM supports PKCS#11 3.0 and provide a sample PKCS11 label for the imported key? If they only support vendor API we'll need an adapter.

fran_partner: They said PKCS#11 + vendor REST API both available. They will drop a test PKCS11 module in staging.

jordan_eng: One more: we should run an end-to-end test that includes SCIM provisioning -> SAML login -> launch a model that does server-side encryption with BYOK and verify logs across systems. I can write the smoke test harness.

sara_pm: Great. Owners: alex_m (KMS), jordan_eng (SSO/SCIM + smoke tests), fran_partner (partner coordination), sara_pm (marketplace + comms), emma_sales (sales enablement).

fran_partner: I'll consolidate into a single checklist and ping legal for embargo. Target: draft checklist by EOD tomorrow.

emma_sales: I'll prep the co-brand kit and a 10-min demo script.

alex_m: FYI here's a sample curl to test key unwrap we will use against staging KMS (placeholders):
```
curl -X POST https://staging-cryptolock-kms.redwood-internal/api/v1/unwrap \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"wrapped_key":"BASE64WRAP","key_label":"cryptokey-01"}'
```

fran_partner: Perfect. I'll follow up with Cryptolock PM and set a short sync for tomorrow 09:30 PT. @sara_pm @alex_m @jordan_eng please confirm availability. :calendar:

sara_pm: I'm in.

alex_m: In.

jordan_eng: In.

ops_bot: reminder: PART-4187 review due in 48h.
